_doc: The @rule snapshot record of the loops, graphs and gates release, its fallback line, and Tier R. Run by shared-types gateRuleRecord.ts (and its @intutic/gate copy and the JavaScript hook gates' embedded source) and intutic_clawde/gate/rule_record.py (and the bash gates). valid: encodeGateRuleRecord(record) is line, and decodeGateRuleRecord(line) is record; the line's payload is the record without kind, fallbackId and rollout, which are columns 3, 2 and 4. served: toServedGateRecord(record, sopId) is served (the shape policy resolve serves as gateRecords), and fromServedGateRecord(served) is record. damaged: decodeGateRuleRecord(line) is null, so the fallback line stays in force. format: a snapshot with any @rule record is @format 3. fallbacks: gateRuleFallback(record), the line an older gate refuses with. compile: compileSopGateRecords(entry, parseFrontMatterEnforcing(front), sha256) (TypeScript only: the writers are the daemon, the CLI and the control plane), as records and the ids of the fallback lines. evaluate: evaluateGateRuleRecords(records, call) as {refusal, shadow}. planResponse: gateRulePlanFromResponse(status, body), the session plan read from GET /api/v1/plans/session/:sessionId (status null: unreachable).
